slots.name: Native-serving funding share
slots.sentence: The average grant to Native-exclusive causes in 2024 was $111,200.

slots.name: Native-exclusive funding share
slots.sentence: Notably, the median grant flowing to Native-exclusive causes in 2024 was significantly below that average: just $20,000.

slots.name: Average Native grant
slots.sentence: Our analysis shows the average grant to Native-exclusive causes in 2024 was $111,200.

slots.name: Median Native grant
slots.sentence: In 2024, just 0.51% of foundation and corporate funding in the Candid dataset went to grants that Brookings analysis could confirm exclusively served Native communities.

slots.name: Native-serving funding percentage
slots.sentence: This analysis finds that just 0.88% of foundation and corporate philanthropic funding in the Candid database was classified as serving Native communities or causes (inclusive of grants that also served other populations).
